tagline: Route important Gmail messages to Microsoft Teams channels automatically
metaTitle: Gmail for Teams: Route Important Emails to Teams Channels
metaDescription: Send client emails, system alerts, and a daily digest from Gmail to the Teams channels, filtered by urgency. GAIA drafts replies too. See the setup steps.
intro:
Organizations that use Google Workspace for email but Microsoft 365 for team collaboration face a constant bridging problem. Important emails arrive in Gmail while the team is active in Microsoft Teams. Colleagues who need to know about a client email, system alert, or vendor communication have to be individually forwarded threads, creating email overload and losing the collaborative context that channels provide.

GAIA closes that gap so that critical email communications surface automatically in the right channels. Client emails can post to a #clients channel. System alerts can go to #monitoring. Financial notifications can appear in a #finance channel. Your Teams workspace becomes informed by Gmail events in real time, and your team can discuss and respond there rather than jumping between platforms.

This integration is essential for organizations in hybrid technology environments — using Google Workspace for email but Microsoft 365 for Office apps and team collaboration — and for teams where different departments have standardized on different platforms.

useCases.title: Client email alerts to Teams channels
useCases.description: When a priority client sends an email, GAIA posts a formatted summary to the designated channel so the whole account team is immediately aware and can coordinate a response in Teams without waiting for someone to forward the email.

useCases.title: System and infrastructure alert routing
useCases.description: Monitoring services that send email alerts can have those alerts forwarded by GAIA to your #ops or #monitoring channel so your engineering team sees them immediately in the chat app they are already working in.

useCases.title: Daily email digest in Teams
useCases.description: GAIA posts a morning summary of your key unread messages directly to your personal chat so you can triage your inbox without opening it, seeing the most important emails summarized in the collaboration tool you start your day in.

useCases.title: Cross-platform reply drafting
useCases.description: When your team discusses a client email in the channel and reaches a decision, you can ask GAIA to draft the reply based on that conversation thread, composing the response with the agreed content and queuing it for your review in Gmail.

useCases.title: New lead and inquiry notifications
useCases.description: Contact form submissions and sales inquiry emails that land in the inbox are routed by GAIA to your sales channel with the prospect's details and inquiry summary so your sales team can immediately discuss and assign follow-up within the channel.

howItWorks.step: Connect Gmail and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your email account and your Microsoft 365 organization in GAIA. GAIA uses Microsoft Graph API and webhooks to post to specific channels, and Google OAuth to read email.

howItWorks.step: Configure your routing and notification rules
howItWorks.description: Specify which Gmail labels, senders, or email categories should trigger notifications, which channels each type should go to, and what format the messages should take—full email, summary, or custom template.
GAIA monitors your inbox continuously and posts to channels as qualifying emails arrive. Your team stays informed without anyone manually relaying information between the two apps.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post to Teams private channels as well as public ones?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can post to any channel—public, private, or shared—where it has been granted permission. During setup, you specify which channels it should have access to, and it will only post where authorized.

faqs.question: Can GAIA include email attachments in the notification?
faqs.answer: It can reference attachments in the message and provide a link back to the original email thread. Uploading binary attachments directly is supported for common file types. For large files, GAIA recommends linking to a shared Google Drive location instead.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support conditional routing — for example, only posting emails above a certain urgency level?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can assess email urgency using AI classification and only route emails that meet your defined threshold. This prevents your channels from being flooded with low-priority notifications.
